creative_direction: Portray a compact penguin wearing a short coat made from translucent amber lantern panels. The coat fits around its body like a small geometric shell, with one flipper tucked inside and the other resting along the edge. Keep the penguin face natural, with a short beak and calm eyes, avoiding human anatomy. Cool blue feathers contrast with warm light contained inside the panels. Use a deep navy background and a narrow pale reflection beneath the feet. Render panel seams and a few feather planes carefully, leaving the rest simple. The character fills the center of the square with its head, coat, and feet safely inside the circular avatar crop.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
